# Provenance inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/provenance_inventory.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

MotionKernel is an independently maintained, MIT-licensed fork of [RightNow-AI/AutoKernel](https://github.com/RightNow-AI/autokernel). This file records exactly what was inherited and what was not, per file, against the upstream commit the project diverged from (`7843582`).

It is generated from the Git history, so it can be regenerated and checked rather than trusted:

```bash
python scripts/provenance_inventory.py --check
```

## Licensing

The upstream MIT license and copyright (`Copyright (c) 2026 RightNow AI`) are preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE) and cover every file below that is not marked *MotionKernel-original*. Files marked *modified descendant* are derivative works and remain covered by the same notice. No file has had an upstream copyright header removed.

## Summary

| Category | Files | Python lines | Share of Python |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Unchanged from upstream | 45 | 9580 | 21.5% |
| Modified descendants | 9 | 3615 | 8.1% |
| MotionKernel-original | 140 | 31321 | 70.4% |
| **Total** | **194** | **44516** | |

Inherited Python footprint (unchanged plus modified): **29.6%**. The remaining 70.4% -- the artifact format, graph discovery, spec generation, the workload system, the optimizer control plane, validation and promotion, the CLI, and the FastVideo bridge -- is MotionKernel work.

The largest remaining visible dependency is the `autokernel` import namespace, which is a compatibility namespace rather than the product name. See [docs/NAMESPACE_MIGRATION.md](docs/NAMESPACE_MIGRATION.md).
